description: EveryDay VISA offers 5 percent cashback on grocery shopping, 8 percent cashback on selected fuel brands, and 0.3 percent cashback on all other spend. It fits customers with strong grocery and fuel usage who want low annual fees.

LiveFresh VISA gives up to 5 percent cashback on online and Visa contactless spend plus extra green cashback on selected eateries, retailers, and transport services. It is designed for younger customers with digital and lifestyle spending.

Miles and More VISA earns 10 miles per dollar on Kaligo hotel bookings, 6 miles on Expedia travel packages, 3 miles on online flights and hotel purchases, 2 miles on overseas spend, and 1.2 miles on local spend. It suits customers who travel frequently and want to maximize miles.

Vantage VISA earns 1.5 miles per dollar on local spend, 2.2 miles on foreign spend, up to 6 miles per dollar on Expedia bookings, and fuel savings at Esso. It is aimed at affluent customers who want premium travel rewards.
Super VISA delivers 10X points on online purchases, 3X points on overseas purchases, and 1X points on all other spend. It works well for customers whose spending is concentrated online.
